snippet.title: Mall Tidy Up Frenemies | Official Co-op Trailer
snippet.description:
A whole mall is a mess, and you and 7 friends have to put it back.

  Wishlist Mall Tidy Up Frenemies on Steam:
  https://store.steampowered.com/app/5077080/

  Every product on the floor tells you where it goes. Read the name, the
  brand and the box art, work out the store, the section and the shelf,
  then haul it there. Or just throw it. A good throw counts.

  You all restore one mall together. You also race each other for credit.
  The standings show who shelved the most, and the boards keep score long
  after the run is over. Winning gets you nothing but bragging rights,
  which is the whole point.

  WHAT YOU DO
  - Co-op for up to 8 players, or play solo with AI bots
  - Carry an armful of products and shelve them where they belong
  - Throw products across the aisle onto the right shelf
  - Finish a shelf, finish a store, finish the mall
  - Earn XP and spend perk points on a big perk tree

  ABILITIES YOU UNLOCK
  - Match Glow lights up every item that belongs on the shelf you are at
  - Tidy Toss sends a product flying to its home from across the store
  - Product Recall pulls matching items to you from the floor
  - Row Claim calls a row for yourself so nobody else takes it
  - Snatch takes a product straight out of a rival's hands
  - Slick drops a slippery patch for whoever walks through it
  - Fus Store Dah is a shout that blows loose products across the floor
  - Trip Up knocks a friend over with a well aimed throw

  Nobody can undo your work. No ability un-shelves an item or breaks
  anything. The mall only ever gets tidier. Your friends just get in the
  way.

  Playable in 15 languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish,
  Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Swedish, Japanese,
  Korean, Chinese (Simplified) and Arabic.

  Follow the game:
  Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5077080/

  #malltidyup #MallTidyUpFrenemies #CoopGames #IndieGame #Simulator
